subject: Expo badge scanner -> HubSpot sync: consent text, mapping, and test plan

From: Sophie Barnes <sophie@eventtech.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ExpoLead badge scanner + HubSpot sync — next steps

Hi Marissa,

Great chatting earlier. As discussed, Nimbus' badge-scanning partner (ExpoOps) can stream badge-read leads in real time to a webhook. I attached the vendor integration guide for their scanners — it includes payload examples and a sample CSV export.

Before we schedule the test, we need to align on:
- Exact HubSpot fields you want populated (we can do real-time create/update).
- Consent language that will be displayed on the tablets / sign-up forms (GDPR/CPRA compliant).
- Dedup keys (email vs. badge id vs. phone).
- Retry/backfill: vendor prefers webhook + daily CSV fallback.

Can you confirm a contact on your side (and whether HubSpot is primary or if you want Salesforce as well)? Also — do you have a sandbox HubSpot portal we can point at for the test?

Attaching: badge_scanner_integration_guide.pdf (vendor doc)

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Barnes
Partnerships, EventTech / Nimbus Events (vendor)

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ExpoLead badge scanner + HubSpot sync — next steps

Hi Sophie — thanks, and thanks for the guide. Copying Vanessa (Sales Ops) and Rishi (AE) to align on HubSpot / dedupe.

Quick answers / requests from our side:
- HubSpot will be primary for event capture. We can mirror to Salesforce later, but for go-live let's write directly to HubSpot.
- Required HubSpot fields we need populated: first_name, last_name, email, company, job_title, phone, lead_source (enum), event_id, badge_id, opt_in_timestamp, gdpr_consent (yes/no). See attached draft mapping (I will export CSV after Vanessa reviews).
- Consent language (we need a short on-screen statement and an opt-in checkbox). Draft copy attached as consent_copy_v1.docx. Please review for vendor placement (tablet UI) and sign-off for legal.
- Dedup: primary key = email; fallback key = badge_id; if neither, use phone + event_id. Please ensure badge_id is surfaced in the webhook payload.
- For real-time: vendor webhook -> our integration middleware -> HubSpot API. For backfill: daily CSV ingestion into the same middleware.

Next steps:
1) Sophie/Tristan: share vendor webhook sample and whether they support HMAC signing for replay protection.
2) Vanessa/Rishi: confirm HubSpot sandbox portal and field mapping.
3) I'll schedule a 30-min test call for the webhook handshake and a dry run for Feb 24.

Attachments: consent_copy_v1.docx (internal draft)

Marissa Cole
Sr. Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -0800

Thanks Marissa / Sophie — Tristan from ExpoOps here (vendor tech lead).

We support a JSON webhook with HMAC-SHA256 signing (X-Expo-Sig header) and a daily CSV export. Example webhook payload attached in the vendor guide (see badge_scanner_integration_guide.pdf). Minimal required fields we push: badge_id, timestamp, first_name, last_name, email (optional), phone (optional), company, raw_scan_location.

Sample webhook endpoint (test): https://hooks.expo-ops.com/test/abc123
We can add a transformation rule to emit email if the badge includes it, otherwise badge_id only.

I'll make sure our team includes the badge_id and an event_id field in every payload. Happy to join the Feb 24 test at the time you propose.

Contact: Tristan Hughes, Lead Integrations, ExpoOps
tristan@expo-ops.com | +1 206-555-7432

Vanessa / Rishi — following up with the vendor notes above. I exported a first-pass HubSpot field map and attached as hubspot_field_map.csv. Key details in the CSV: hubspot_field, source_field, transform (if any). Two asks from Ops: 1) make lead_source a picklist with value 'Event — Nimbus Expo 2026', 2) set dedupe rule to prefer email then badge_id.

For the consent text we want: a short line on the tablet close to the submit button. Current draft (consent_copy_v1.docx) reads: "By providing my badge or contact details I consent to receive communications from Redwood Inference about products and events. I can opt out at any time." Can we tighten for GDPR: add a controller statement and a link to privacy policy. Sophie — can you confirm this placement on the tablet UI?

Tentative test schedule: Feb 24, 10:00–10:30 PT — webhook handshake, create one test lead with email, create one test lead with only badge_id, and backfill one CSV row. Please confirm availability.

Thanks,
Marissa

All good from Sales Ops — confirmed the HubSpot sandbox: portal 12345 (https://app.hubspot.com/portal/12345). I reviewed hubspot_field_map.csv and made two small changes (see notes inline):
- Map hubspot property 'lead_source' -> constant 'Event — Nimbus Expo 2026' (picklist created).
- Added transform to normalize phone to E.164.

Dedup: we'll set rule to match on email OR badge_id. If both present, HubSpot will merge based on email as primary.

Security note: Tristan, please enable HMAC signing on the webhook and share the key securely (we'll store in our middleware). For GDPR: add the controller clause to the copy: "Redwood Inference (Controller) will process your data; see https://redwood.ai/privacy for details." That should be sufficient for the tablet UI.

I approve the mapping for the test. Marissa — please schedule the Feb 24 call; Rishi and I will join. On the day of the show we'll ensure a fallback CSV ingestion plan if the webhook misses any records.
